summary.oneLiner: Hyderabad-based manufacturer of classical and proprietary Ayurvedic formulations and nutraceutical supplements, running a hybrid model of own-brand doctor-detailed products alongside third-party contract manufacturing.
summary.business: Himalaya Nutravedics India Limited manufactures, markets and distributes Ayurvedic formulations and nutraceutical products in India and undertakes third-party contract manufacturing for similar companies. Its portfolio spans classical (Shastric) Ayurvedic formulations, proprietary Ayurvedic products and nutraceutical supplements across softgel and hardgel capsules, tablets, liquid orals, medicated oils and protein powders, covering gut health, immunity, metabolic health, musculoskeletal and joint wellness, reproductive vitality, respiratory wellness, pain management and general wellness. …
